//: Type checking of the map app by JSDoc and checkJs (REFACTOR-PLAN.md item 2, slice TS-3). Was src/tsconfig.check.json until rf9-mapapp (12 Nov 2026) moved src/ into packages/map/src/; the include paths are relative to packages/map/. Run by `npm run check:types:mapapp`. Named tsconfig.check.json, not tsconfig.json, so esbuild (the app bundler) never reads it. The include list is an allowlist that only grows (tests/unit/map-typecheck.test.mjs): the pure modules first; a method module of packages/map/src/app/ joins with a typed `this`: each method's `@this {MapApp & <its methods class>}`, MapApp being the app as src/app/map-app.d.ts declares it (rf9-mapapp, 12 Nov 2026; tests/unit/map-app-host.test.mjs holds the declaration to the code). A file joins only when what it imports is clean too: a JS file the check reaches is checked, so a module that imports ui-controller.js waits for it. strictNullChecks is on (round 3): the election models' loose records are typed in packages/core/src/election-view-model.mjs (ElectionRecord, ElectionResult, ElectionContext), and tests/unit/map-typecheck.test.mjs fails if it is turned off. noImplicitAny is on (noImplicitAny review, 8 Nov 2026): every parameter has a JSDoc type, and the same test fails if it is turned off. Full `strict` since 12 Nov 2026 (stream rf8-types: strictPropertyInitialization and strictBuiltinIteratorReturn found nothing), each flag also set here.
